tasks_completed.description: Removed flexWrap:'wrap' from CommandView.tsx styles.line to unlock horizontal scroll in all three CommandView callers
tasks_completed.changes: CommandView.tsx:45 — removed `flexWrap: 'wrap'` from styles.line (was 3rd property in {alignItems, flexDirection, flexWrap}, now just {alignItems, flexDirection})
tasks_completed.rationale: flexWrap:'wrap' forced the command Text to wrap at parent row's bounded width, defeating the outer horizontal ScrollView in SidebarBashView / BashViewFull / CodexBashView bash branch. BA spec Fix A at CommandView.tsx:45.

tasks_completed.description: Removed flex:1 from CommandView.tsx styles.commandText to let the command render at intrinsic text width
tasks_completed.changes: CommandView.tsx:59 — removed `flex: 1` from styles.commandText (was 5th/last property, now removed so commandText keeps only font/size/color/lineHeight)
tasks_completed.rationale: flex:1 on a Text inside a flex row resolves against the parent row's bounded width (popup frame), making the Text occupy exactly that width. ScrollView's contentSize == containerSize, so zero scroll extent. Removing flex:1 lets Text render at its intrinsic monospace width, which feeds the outer ScrollView's scroll extent for long commands.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 (BA-attributed; QA-BA pass-with-minor-issues note attributes actual introduction to PR #408 86919918 2026-01-22 — metadata nit only, doesn't change fix direction)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Original CommandView design used flexWrap:'wrap' + flex:1 expecting to wrap gracefully inside plain View containers. When SidebarBashView / BashViewFull later wrapped CommandView in a horizontal ScrollView, flex:1 on the Text continued to resolve against the bounded parent width (ScrollView content width == visible width), giving zero horizontal-scroll extent. flexWrap:'wrap' reinforced the visual wrapping symptom.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Removes the two style properties that constrain the command Text to the parent's bounded width. Without them, Text renders at intrinsic monospace character width, which exceeds the popup frame for long commands — the outer ScrollView now measures a scroll content width larger than its visible area and horizontal scroll becomes functional. All three callers (SidebarBashView, BashViewFull, post-P3 CodexBashView) already have the correct outer ScrollView + commandWrapper minWidth:'100%' wrapping — no caller-side change needed.

blast_radius.impact_note: All three importers already wrap CommandView in `<ScrollView horizontal>` + `<View style={{flex:1, minWidth:'100%'}}>`. Removing flexWrap+flex:1 from CommandView unlocks horizontal scroll for all three simultaneously with zero caller-side changes. No non-scrolling consumers of CommandView exist.
